heading: 17.5 `int64`-time ↔ `float64`-frequency formulas: pin the float→int rounding

### 17.5 `int64`-time ↔ `float64`-frequency formulas: pin the float→int rounding [LUNI.17.5]

Pinned in [§7.2]: a `float64` value cast into an
`int64`-typed storage field uses IEEE 754 `roundTiesToEven`. The
`hz_to_period(x) = 1e9 / x` formula and any other `float64`-producing
conversion that lands in the `time` dimension applies the same rule at the
final cast, so platforms do not diverge by ±1 ns.
